device.name: SensorPush HT1 / HTP.xw
device.notes:
Protocol documented via community reverse engineering and now openly by the vendor.
Primary source: SensorPush Bluetooth API documentation
(https://www.sensorpush.com/bluetooth-api), which publishes the full 2nd-generation
GATT table; corroborated by sensorpush-bleak (cryptomcgrath, 5★) and
sensorpush-ble (Bluetooth-Devices).
Two hardware generations: HT1 (V1, thermometer + hygrometer) and HTP.xw (V2,
thermometer + hygrometer + barometer). HT1 is the only model excluded from the
vendor's open protocol documentation.
TI CC2540/CC2541 BLE SoC. Uses OAD (Over-the-Air Download) firmware update service.
Temperature/humidity accessed via write-then-read pattern: write 4-byte trigger, ~110ms delay, then read.
Values are 4-byte signed int LE in hundredths (vendor doc: "4 Byte Signed Int LE";
a u16 cannot encode the -40 °C bottom of the HT1 range).
History data retrieved in bulk notification chunks with 4-byte timestamp header.
Device reports battery voltage + raw temperature sensor in Battery Info characteristic.
Uses SensorPush BLE Advertisement Detection: name/address prefix check plus UUID slicing.
The Android app (v4.5.9, legacy package com.cousins_sears.beaconthermometer) ships a
definitions table (res/raw/definitions.json) confirming the device-version IDs:
1=HT1, 64=HTP.xw, 65=HT.w, 66=TC.x, 67=Aqua (binary water-leak sensor, 1-byte
timestamped samples). The app matches the primary service by UUID prefix
ef090000-11d6-42ba-93b8-9dd7ec090a* rather than an exact generation UUID.
Two app-side behaviours worth knowing: (1) a factory-recovery flow for sensors whose
DeviceID reads as 0 or 0xFFFFFFFF (uninitialized/flash-error), which exposes a
separate initial-config service ee090000-11d6-42ba-93b8-9dd7ec090ab0 through which
the app rewrites the device identity; (2) an optional write-challenge/read-response
security exchange performed during app "activation" as an anti-counterfeit check
(skipped on firmware that lacks it) — it is not required to read sensor data.

credentials.notes: BLE-only; no WiFi passphrase crosses the link. The connection is unauthenticated, so readings and logged history are available to anyone in range.

factory_reset.effect: Vendor-documented: there is no factory reset function. Removing and replacing the battery resets the firmware; the app separately offers a "Clear Data" reset for logged history. The device exposes a TI OAD firmware-update service on adjacent handles — guessing at opcodes near that is how a sensor ends up in bootloader mode. Battery pull is the only safe state change.

methods.description: Connect over GATT and read temperature and humidity with the write-then-read pattern: write the 4-byte trigger, wait ~110 ms, then read the result.

steps.action: Insert the battery; the sensor advertises continuously from power-on.
Scan for the SensorPush name/address prefix and match the primary service UUID to identify the generation — ...090aa9 for HT1, ...090ab0 for HTP.xw.
Connect over GATT. No pairing is requested.
Write the 4-byte trigger to the measurement characteristic, wait 110 ms, then read it back.
steps.expect: A current temperature and humidity reading (barometric pressure also on HTP.xw via ef090082).

setup.notes:
Nothing is provisioned. The sensor advertises continuously and serves readings to any client that connects; there is no pairing, bonding or account. The SensorPush app's cloud gateway is a separate product, not a prerequisite for reading the sensor.
Which generation you have decides the service UUID — HT1 (V1) ends ...090aa9, HTP.xw (V2) ends ...090ab0 — so detection must check both.
Confidence is medium: the flow comes from two independent community implementations (sensorpush-bleak, sensorpush-ble) rather than from a run against hardware here.

rejoin.notes: The sensor joins no network. Any client may connect once the previous one disconnects.

variants.notes: Temperature and humidity. No barometer, so the pressure entity does not apply to this one.
Temperature, humidity and barometric pressure; the 'xw' units are the outdoor-rated enclosure.

bulk_sample.description:
Each sample is 4 bytes. Bulk data: [4-byte u32le timestamp] + [N × 4-byte sample records].
All 4 bytes of each sample record are packed payload (encoded temp/humidity fields).
Stop token: 0xFFFFFFFF marks end of valid data.
Note: the "65 = standard reading type prefix" in sensorpush-bleak is a hardcoded
dummy byte that library prepends to select its HT.w (type 65) pack-params —
it is NOT a per-record type byte on the wire.
Packed-sample widths and encoding ranges per the app's shipped definitions
table (res/raw/definitions.json, app v4.5.9): each record packs one value per
dimension as (min, max, step) scaled integers — HT1: 4 bytes/sample, gen-1 raw
fields (no pack params); HTP.xw: 6 bytes — temperature (-40..140 °C, step
0.0025), humidity (0..100 %RH, step 0.0025), pressure (30000..125000 Pa, step
1); HT.w: 4 bytes — temperature (-40..125 °C, step 0.0025), humidity (0..100,
step 0.0025); TC.x: 2 bytes — thermocouple temperature (-200..1800 °C, step
0.0625, minimum value = probe-disconnected null); Aqua: 1 byte — water present
(0..1, step 1, timestamped sample mode).

temperature.description: Signed 32-bit LE, hundredths of °C (vendor doc; signed matters below 0 °C)

characteristics.description: Device unique identifier (fixed 4 bytes, uint32, read-only per vendor doc; a write attempt causes immediate disconnection)
characteristics.name: DeviceID

characteristics.description: 7-byte firmware revision: i1_i2.i3_i4.i5_i6.i7 format
characteristics.name: RevisionCode

characteristics.description: TX power, read/write (vendor doc): valid -21..+5 dBm; observed value 5 = +5 dBm default
characteristics.name: TxPower

characteristics.description: Logging sample interval in seconds (integer)
characteristics.name: SampleInterval

characteristics.description: Advertising interval, uint16 read/write (vendor doc), units of 625 us; observed 0x0808 = 2056 = 1285 ms default; 0xFEEF disables advertising entirely until battery pull
characteristics.name: AdvertisingInterval

characteristics.description: 4 bytes: [battery_voltage_u16le / 1000 = volts, raw_temp_u16le]
characteristics.name: BatteryInfo

characteristics.description: Device clock (4 bytes, u32le, seconds since Unix epoch)
characteristics.name: Timestamp

characteristics.description: Bulk sample data block (timestamp + 4-byte sample records)
characteristics.name: BulkData27

characteristics.description: Bulk sample data block (remote history retrieval)
characteristics.name: BulkData29

characteristics.description: Unknown characteristic at handle 32 (vendor V2 table: RESERVED)
characteristics.name: Unknown32

characteristics.description: LED control, read/write (vendor doc)
characteristics.name: LEDControl

characteristics.description: MAC address, 6 bytes, read-only (vendor doc)
characteristics.name: MACAddress

characteristics.description: Temperature in °C. Write 4-byte trigger (0x01000100), wait 110ms, read 4-byte int32le / 100 (vendor doc: 4 Byte Signed Int LE; a u16 cannot encode -40 °C)
characteristics.name: Temperature

characteristics.description: Humidity in %RH. Write 4-byte trigger (0x01000100), wait 110ms, read 4-byte int32le / 100 (vendor doc: 4 Byte Signed Int LE)
characteristics.name: Humidity

characteristics.description: Barometric pressure (station pressure) in hundredths of Pa, 4-byte int32le / 100 (vendor Bluetooth API doc). HTP.xw (V2) only; follows the same write-then-read trigger pattern as temperature/humidity.
characteristics.name: BarometricPressure

services.description: Primary GATT service for HT1 (temperature + humidity)
services.name: SensorPush Service (V1/HT1)
services.notes: V2/HTP.xw (temperature + humidity + barometric pressure) exposes the counterpart service ef090000-11d6-42ba-93b8-9dd7ec090ab0 carrying the same …aa9 characteristics (vendor Bluetooth API documentation).

characteristics.description: TI OAD firmware image identification
characteristics.name: OADImageIdentify

characteristics.description: TI OAD firmware image block transfer
characteristics.name: OADImageBlock

characteristics.name: OADControl

characteristics.description: Device ID, rewritten during recovery (0 / 0xFFFFFFFF = uninitialized or flash error)
characteristics.name: DeviceID

characteristics.description: MAC address, rewritten during recovery
characteristics.name: MACAddress

characteristics.description: Logging sample interval, written during recovery
characteristics.name: SampleInterval

characteristics.description: Advertising interval (625 us units), written during recovery
characteristics.name: AdvertisingInterval

characteristics.description: TX power; the recovery flow sets value 4 when re-activating a sensor
